0.title: Biometric Passport - Embassy of Algeria in Washington
0.text: Validity: The validity of the biometric passport is 10 years for adults and 5 years for minors under 19. Minors: A minor is entitled to an individual passport at any age. Adding a child to a parent's passport is no longer allowed. Applications for anyone under 19 require written parental authorization from the father or legal guardian, who must sign the form. If the applicant is a child, the legal guardian completes the form's annex. Application steps: The applicant must appear in person to have a photo taken and fingerprints collected, and again to submit the application and to collect the passport. Children exempt from electronic fingerprint scanning at submission don't need to return for pickup.

5.title: Issuing passport for the first time - Consulate General of Algeria in Milan
5.text: Submission: The submission of the application file must be made by the person concerned, in person, during consulate opening hours (Tuesday to Saturday). Children under 12 do not need to attend if their photos meet the required standards. Children over 12 must be accompanied by their father, their mother if she is not Algerian, or their legal guardian. Required documents (original plus one copy): - Valid consular registration card - Completed, dated and signed passport form (collected at the consulate or downloaded) - 12S birth certificate - Marriage certificate extract or divorce judgment extract, if applicable - Written statement confirming blood group, or a document proving it - Residence permit, or Italian identity card for dual nationals - Work certificate, for applicants who work -

Those born in Algeria can request the 12S online or from their birth municipality. Fees: standard chancery fee 60 euros; students and minor children 30 euros.

Collection: Check passport availability on the Consulate General's website; collect when notified by individual SMS; bring the submission receipt and the old passport, even if still valid. The holder must be present. Minors are collected by their legal guardian or mother, who needs a procuration approved by the municipality or consular services. The 12S birth certificate is returned with the passport, with the National Identification Number (NIN) printed. Deadline: The passport must be withdrawn by its holder as soon as he is informed.

13.title: Passport renewal - Consulate General of Algeria in London
13.text: Algerian biometric passport renewal - required documents: - The original and a photocopy of your expired Algerian biometric passport. - A valid consular registration card. - A completed application form, signed by the applicant or, for minors, by a legal guardian. - The original special birth extract (form 12s), needed only if the expired passport was not issued by the London consulate. - The original and a copy of proof of lawful residence in the UK, such as leave to remain, a student or work visa, or a British passport. Holders of other European passports must provide the Home Office blue card. - Four passport photos meeting the required standards, with your name and surname written on the back. - A work certificate, or an enrolment certificate for students and schoolchildren.

Fees: - Standard renewal: 55 GBP, paid in cash only at the time of application. - Students and children under 19: 27.50 GBP. Students must also present a valid student certificate. Passport availability can be checked online at https://services.mfa.gov.dz/fr/emblondon/passport by entering the application registration number from the deposit receipt.

15.title: Biometric documents (passport, ID card, 12S) - Embassy of Algeria in Washington
15.text: Biometric passport: Validity is 10 years for adults and 5 years for minors under 19. Minors need their own individual passport and can no longer be added to a parent's passport. The applicant must appear in person for the photo and fingerprints, and for submission and pickup; children exempt from electronic fingerprint scanning don't need to attend pickup. Biometric passports are issued in Algeria; allow at least 6 weeks between biometric enrollment and receiving the passport. Fees are payable only by individual U.S. Post Office money order, made out to the Embassy of Algeria: 28-page $75 (adults 19+), $37.50 (minors and students); 48-page $112.50 (adults 19+), $56.25 (minors and students). Minors require written parental authorization from the father or legal guardian.

16.title: Biometric documents (passport, ID card, 12S) - Embassy of Algeria in Washington
16.text: 48-page $112.50 (adults 19+), $56.25 (minors and students). Minors require written parental authorization from the father or legal guardian. For a lost, stolen or damaged passport, provide a notarized declaration explaining the circumstances, plus a $125 penalty paid by money order. Photo specs: 3.5 x 4.5 cm, white background, no frame, face 32-36 mm (or 75% of the frame), centered, taken within six months. Photos that don't meet the requirements will be REJECTED. Passports not collected are destroyed six months after the pickup notice, under Algerian law 14-03. National identity card: Required: valid consular registration card, application form, three recent passport-size photos, and the expired ID card. No fee.

17.title: Biometric documents (passport, ID card, 12S) - Embassy of Algeria in Washington
17.text: identity card: Required: valid consular registration card, application form, three recent passport-size photos, and the expired ID card. No fee. 12-S birth certificate: Required for the biometric passport and issued once in a lifetime. Residents of NC, SC, DE, MD, VA, WV and DC apply at the Washington embassy; residents of the other 44 states apply to the New York Consulate. Process varies by birthplace: Algerian-born applicants go to the local city hall or the Interior Ministry website; U.S.-born applicants go to the Ministry or Embassy; those born elsewhere follow transcription-based procedures. Contacts: Passports (202) 265-2800 ext. 128; 12-S (202) 265-2800 ext. 169.

18.title: Identity Card - Embassy of Algeria in Washington
18.text: Requirements and documents: - Valid consular registration card. - Application Form available at the Embassy. - Three (3) similar recent passport-sized photographs. - Expired National Identity Card. Fees: No fee is required. Steps: 1. Confirm eligibility: you must be a community member in the Embassy's consular area and hold a biometric passport and a national identity number (NIN). 2. Apply online for the biometric national identity card (CNIBE) at https://passeport.interieur.gov.dz/fr/demandeCNIBE_fr/demande. 3. Track your application using the tracking link on the page.

19.title: The National Identity Card - Consulate General of Algeria in Milan
19.text: Biometric National Identity Card. Eligibility: Algerian citizens permanently residing abroad who have completed consular registration. Applying online: Any applicant, of any age, can apply after obtaining a biometric passport at https://passeport.interieur.gov.dz/fr/DemandeCNIBE_Fr/Demande At the Consulate: Children under 12 are exempt from fingerprinting, so they don't need to attend the application or collection. Applicants aged 12 and over must attend for fingerprinting without a prior appointment. Renewal documents (original and copy): - Valid consular registration card - Completed and signed renewal form - Two recent standard photos - Form 12-S birth certificate - Expired ID card Collection: The new card is collected at the Consulate General with a valid identity document.

20.title: The National Identity Card - Consulate General of Algeria in Milan
20.text: - Form 12-S birth certificate - Expired ID card Collection: The new card is collected at the Consulate General with a valid identity document. Condition: The issue of the new document is subject to the return of the old Algerian identity card, whether it is valid or expired. Fees: The page does not list any fees.

21.title: The National Identity Card - Consulate General of Algeria in London
21.text: The Algerian Consulate in London, for the Algerian community in the UK and Republic of Ireland, announces an online service from the Ministry of Interior. Algerian nationals who hold a biometric passport can apply for the biometric national identity card (CNIBE) through the portal at https://passeport.interieur.gov.dz/fr/demandeCNIBE_fr/demande. When collecting the biometric ID card: - Bring an original identity document. - Return your old ID card to the consulate. - If the old card is lost, bring a declaration of lost document. The page does not list fees, processing times, or other application steps.

22.title: Identity Cards - Consulate General of Algeria in San Francisco
22.text: Conditions: - Open to Algerian citizens who live abroad permanently and are registered with the Consulate General. - After getting a biometric passport, applicants can apply online with their National Identification Number (NIN). - Children under 12 cannot apply. - Applicants 12 and older must visit the Consulate General for fingerprinting. - Submitting the application by mail before the visit is recommended. - Renewal is possible six months before expiration. - Cards are issued in Algeria, so delivery usually takes several weeks. - Applications can be tracked with the number on your receipt; status can be checked on the Ministry of the Interior website about one week after fingerprinting. Fees: - Free for first-time applicants or if you still have your old ID.

25.title: 12S Birth Certificate - Embassy of Algeria in Washington

28.title: 12-S - Consulate General of Algeria in London
28.text: What it is: The 12S is an extract of a birth certificate on secure paper. You can obtain it only once in your lifetime, and it is required before a biometric passport can be issued. How to get it: 1. Town Hall where you were born, if you were born in Algeria. 2. Online through the Ministry of the Interior's portal (demande12s.interieur.gov.dz). 3. By proxy: authorize someone in Algeria to collect it for you. The proxy must be arranged at the consulate. 4. Consulate of Algeria in London, if you were born in the UK and the birth was registered there. 5. Civil Status Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Algiers, if you were born abroad and live in Algeria, provided the birth was registered at the relevant embassy or consulate.

29.title: 12-S - Consulate General of Algeria in London

30.title: Certificate S12 - Consulate General of Algeria in Istanbul
30.text: What S12 is: An official civil status document, issued by the municipality or diplomatic/consular center of the person's birth place, that allows a national identification number to be created. Citizens born abroad and registered at the Istanbul Consulate General: requests are forwarded to the diplomatic or consular mission where the birth occurred, along with the birthplace and birth registration details. Citizens born in Algeria, living abroad, and registered at the consulate: the S12 (needed for a biometric passport or national ID card) can be obtained by: - Submitting an online request through the official Algerian government site. - Booking an appointment at the Istanbul Consular Center, where the document is stamped.

31.title: Certificate S12 - Consulate General of Algeria in Istanbul
31.text: request through the official Algerian government site. - Booking an appointment at the Istanbul Consular Center, where the document is stamped. - Giving a power of attorney to someone in Algeria to collect it in the birth commune; the power of attorney must be stamped by consular services. - Collecting it personally if the citizen is in Algeria. Citizens born in Turkey (except Ankara): the Istanbul Consulate accepts S12 requests if the birth certificate is already registered in its civil registers.

32.title: Birth certificate 12S - Embassy of Algeria in Warsaw
32.text: The 12S birth certificate is a secure document required for a biometric passport, based on civil registry records. Eligibility: People born in Algeria and registered with the Embassy can apply, as can parents applying for minor children born in Algeria. Applying: Apply online through the Ministry of the Interior and Local Authorities at http://demande12s.interieur.gov.dz. Processing: After the certificate is generated, it is sent to the diplomatic or consular mission for issuance. Tracking: Check status under the Application Tracking tab on the website's homepage. Collection: When the site shows a message telling you to contact the relevant consulate, visit the civil status service with an Algerian identity document. Minor children under 19 can be included in the collection.

33.title: Civil Status - Embassy of Algeria in Washington
33.text: Civil status registration: - Births: registration requires a copy of the parent's consular card (or the parents' passports if unregistered), the newborn's original full birth certificate, and a family book or marriage certificate copy. - Marriages: Algerians abroad can register marriages at the embassy, which then issues a family book. Applicants need a consular card copy, the original marriage certificate, recent original birth certificates, and a non-Algerian spouse's birth certificate. - Deaths: the family should contact the embassy promptly and use a funeral home to gather proof of citizenship, a medical certificate, the original death certificate, an embalming certificate, and a City Hall transit permit.

34.title: Civil Status - Embassy of Algeria in Washington
34.text: to gather proof of citizenship, a medical certificate, the original death certificate, an embalming certificate, and a City Hall transit permit. Transcription (mandatory before obtaining Algerian documents): based on where the event occurred, not where the person lives. Only acts of persons whose Algerian nationality is established can be transcribed. - Birth: two recent original birth certificates, the family book, and either a nationality certificate or an ID plus ancestors' birth certificates; a parent's ID is needed for minors. - Marriage: two original certificates, the family book, and an Algerian ID. Marriages to non-Muslims require a conversion certificate. Foreign-chancellery and religious marriages need a court order.

39.title: Civil Status - Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Algiers)
39.text: The Civil Status Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs offers three services. 1. Issuing civil status certificates: Algerians born abroad, Algerians whose marriages were registered abroad, and first-degree relatives of someone who died abroad can get copies of birth, marriage or death records already held by Algerian diplomatic or consular posts. Requests can be made at the Ministry's Civil Status Service or at municipal civil status offices nationwide. 2. Transcribing civil status certificates: applicants submit requests to the Ministry's Civil Status Service, which forwards the files to the competent post for entry into its registers.

40.title: Civil Status - Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Algiers)
40.text: applicants submit requests to the Ministry's Civil Status Service, which forwards the files to the competent post for entry into its registers. Required documents: - Birth, Algerian father: a recent full birth certificate from the foreign town hall (less than one year), plus the father's and grandfather's birth certificates. - Birth, Algerian mother and foreign father: the applicant's certificate, plus the mother's, maternal grandfather's and maternal great-grandfather's birth certificates. - Birth, nationality granted by presidential decree: the applicant's recent birth certificate and a copy of the naturalization decree. - The Office may ask for more documents, such as a court nationality certificate or a judicial transcription order, if errors in the files would block transcription.

43.title: Certificate of change of residence and de-registration - Ministry of Foreign Affairs
43.text: Who it applies to: Algerian citizens who were registered at an Algerian diplomatic or consular post abroad and have moved back to Algeria permanently, and who want to renew their identification and travel documents through their municipality of residence. Where to apply: The civil status office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, which issues either a certificate of deregistration or a certificate of change of residence. Documents required: 1. The original Consular Registration Card, or a declaration of loss if the card is missing. 2. A valid copy of the applicant's identification card. 3. A certificate of residence from the administrative services of the municipality where the applicant lives. The page does not list any further steps, fees or processing times.

44.title: Judicial Records (Casier Judiciaire) - Embassy of Algeria in Washington
44.text: The Algerian Embassy in Washington issues copies of judicial records, known as Casier Judiciaire No 3, to Algerians living abroad. Foreign nationals who have lived in Algeria and now reside outside the country can also apply. Applicants need to submit: - A complete original birth certificate - A valid identification document, such as a registration card, passport, or national ID card - For foreign nationals, proof of residence in Algeria - A prepaid, self-addressed return envelope - A signed and completed application form

45.title: Criminal Record - Consulate General of Algeria in London
45.text: UK-based community members registered with the Consulate can obtain a Criminal Record (Casier Judiciaire N 3) through the consulate. The application requires: 1. A completed and signed application form. 2. Proof of identity, namely a copy of a valid consular registration card. 3. The original full copy of the birth certificate (E.C. 12). 4. Proof of residency in Algeria, for foreign nationals. 5. Records are issued only in Arabic or French; the consulate does not provide translations into English or other languages. 6. A pre-paid, self-addressed return envelope. The record is free of charge.

46.title: Formulaire de demande de casier judiciaire - Consulat d'Algérie à Pontoise
46.text: Formulaire de demande d'extrait de casier judiciaire (Bulletin n°3), Consulat d'Algérie à Pontoise, Ministère des Affaires Étrangères. Champs à remplir : - Nom et prénom, écrits en français et en arabe - Nationalité - Sexe : masculin ou féminin - Situation familiale : marié(e), célibataire, divorcé(e), veuf(ve) - Date de naissance - Lieu de naissance - Wilaya (pour les Algériens) ou pays (pour les étrangers) - Numéro de l'acte de naissance - N° d'immatriculation - Prénom du père - Nom et prénom de la mère - Adresse permanente - Profession - Numéro de téléphone - Lieu et date de la demande (France) - Signature du demandeur Instructions : - La demande est strictement personnelle. - Les noms et prénoms doivent être transcrits dans les deux langues.

47.text: Signature du demandeur Instructions : - La demande est strictement personnelle. - Les noms et prénoms doivent être transcrits dans les deux langues. Le formulaire ne liste pas de pièces justificatives.

48.title: Nationality Certificate - Consulate General of Algeria in San Francisco
48.text: Conditions: The Consulate General can issue the Algerian Nationality certificate to Algerian nationals established within the consulate's jurisdiction. Steps: Applications are submitted through the Ministry of Justice platform; after processing by the competent judicial authorities, the applicant receives the certificate, electronically signed and ready for issuance. Documents required: - Application Form completed and signed. - Applicant's Algerian birth certificate in Arabic. - Father's or Mother's Nationality certificate. - Father's or Mother's Algerian birth certificate in Arabic. - Grandfather's Algerian birth certificate in Arabic. - Mother's Grandfather's Algerian birth certificate in Arabic. - Copy of the decree of acquisition of Algerian nationality (if available).

49.title: Nationality Certificate - Consulate General of Algeria in San Francisco
49.text: Arabic. - Mother's Grandfather's Algerian birth certificate in Arabic. - Copy of the decree of acquisition of Algerian nationality (if available). - Executive copy of the final judicial decision confirming the father's or Mother's original Algerian nationality. - Notarized copy of the applicant's official ID (either Algerian or US). Notes: All information in your documents must match. The judicial authority may request corrections to your civil status documents before issuing the certificate. For a faster and safer application return, provide a Priority Mail return envelope from USPS. Fees: the page does not list any fees.

50.title: Members of national community can obtain their nationality certificate online - Consulate General in Brussels
50.text: According to the Ministry of Justice, members of national community living abroad can now obtain their Algerian nationality certificate online. The certificate is signed at the closest diplomatic or consular office abroad, so the applicant does not have to travel to Algeria. The announcement does not state the website address, procedural steps or document requirements.

51.title: Facilitating access for Algerian nationals residing abroad to obtain the Algerian nationality certificate - Embassy in Washington
51.text: The Ministry of Justice states that Algerian nationals living abroad can obtain the Algerian nationality certificate from their nearest Algerian diplomatic or consular mission. The document is digitally signed, and they do not have to travel to Algeria. The notice is part of broader efforts to simplify procedures and offer more judicial services remotely. The notice says the platform is accessible from listed sites, but the links do not appear in the page text. Procedural steps and required documents are not given on this page.

52.title: Driving Qualification Certificate (Certificat de capacité de permis de conduire) - Consulate General in London
52.text: Eligibility: Algerian nationals who live regularly in the UK and are registered with the Algerian diplomatic or consular representation, and who hold a valid Algerian driving licence. How to apply: 1. Register and create an account on the Ministry of Interior's electronic service at https://capacitepc.interieur.gov.dz/. 2. Complete and submit the electronic application form. 3. The authority that issued your driving licence examines the application and electronically sends the certificate to the consulate. 4. The Head of the Consular Post edits and signs the document. Collection: Bring an identity document and proof of residence in the UK. Validity: The certificate is valid for a period of six (06) months.

53.title: Driving Qualification Certificate (Certificat de capacité de permis de conduire) - Consulate General in London
53.text: Collection: Bring an identity document and proof of residence in the UK. Validity: The certificate is valid for a period of six (06) months. Responsibility: Only the Algerian authority that issued the driving licence can issue the certificate. The consulate only delivers it, cannot change it, and is not responsible for delays in issuance. Fees: The page does not mention any fees.

54.title: Driving Certificate - Consulate General of Algeria in San Francisco
54.text: Driving Competence Certificate. Eligibility: Algerian citizens as well as foreigners' holders of an Algerian driving license can apply online. Step 1: Create an account on the Ministry of Interior website at https://capacitepc.interieur.gov.dz/. Step 2: After the account is activated, submit the application. You will receive a receipt, which you should keep. Step 3: Collect the certificate in person at the Consulate General. Bring the receipt, a valid ID, and proof of US residency. Validity: The certificate is valid for six months. Fees: The page does not list any fees.

55.title: ANAE - Agence Nationale de l'Auto-Entrepreneur
55.text: Conditions d'éligibilité pour l'inscription au registre national de l'auto-entrepreneur : - Âge : toute personne physique ayant l'âge légal du travail. - Nationalité : être de nationalité algérienne et résider en Algérie, ou être un étranger résidant en Algérie, selon la réglementation en vigueur. - Activité : exercer une activité figurant sur la liste des activités éligibles. Elle couvre sept domaines : conseil et formation, services numériques, services à la personne, prestations à domicile, loisirs, services aux entreprises, et services culturels et audiovisuels. Inscription et carte : - L'inscription au registre national se fait en ligne, via le lien Obtenir ma Carte ou Inscription sur anae.dz (formulaire : https://anae.dz/user/ae/register).

56.title: ANAE - Agence Nationale de l'Auto-Entrepreneur
56.text: au registre national se fait en ligne, via le lien Obtenir ma Carte ou Inscription sur anae.dz (formulaire : https://anae.dz/user/ae/register). - Le délai moyen de traitement est de 12 à 24 heures. - L'agence indique plus de 4 800 demandes par mois et plus de 100 000 cartes délivrées. Autres informations : - Inscription à l'annuaire de l'auto-entrepreneur ; possibilité de proposer une activité. - Note n° 2024/01 : simplification de l'ouverture de comptes bancaires commerciaux pour les auto-entrepreneurs. - Note du 1er octobre 2024 (n° 2024/133) : le numéro d'identification statistique (NIS) n'est pas obligatoire pour exercer l'activité ou ouvrir un compte bancaire. - Activité de micro-importateur ajoutée par le décret exécutif 25-170 de juin 2025.

58.title: Création de l'agence nationale de l'auto-entrepreneur - ANAE
58.text: Création : Le gouvernement a examiné, lors d'une réunion présidée par le Premier ministre le 5 avril 2023, trois projets de décrets exécutifs relatifs à l'auto-entrepreneur. Statut : L'ANAE est un établissement public à caractère administratif, placé sous la tutelle du ministre de l'Economie de la connaissance, des Start-up et des Micro-entreprises. Missions : Elle vise à réguler les nouvelles activités économiques, notamment numériques, et à favoriser l'auto-emploi des jeunes et leur intégration dans l'économie formelle. Elle met en place et gère le registre national de l'auto-entrepreneur via une plateforme électronique. Comité des activités : Un comité auprès de l'agence gère la liste des activités éligibles et formule des avis et recommandations.

59.title: Création de l'agence nationale de l'auto-entrepreneur - ANAE
59.text: électronique. Comité des activités : Un comité auprès de l'agence gère la liste des activités éligibles et formule des avis et recommandations. Inscription et carte : L'inscription se fait via une plateforme numérique interopérable qui délivre une carte portant un numéro d'immatriculation national unique. La carte est confectionnée électroniquement selon les normes techniques en vigueur. Contact : Alger 16000 ; contact@anae.dz ; +213 23 50 50 38.

60.title: دليل الاستيراد المصغر (Micro-importer guide) - ANAE
60.text: Reference: Executive Decree No. 25-170. Limits: Up to 1,800,000 DZD per trip, with a maximum of two trips per month, converted at the exchange rate on the declaration date. Amounts cannot be combined into one trip or carried over (لا يجوز تجميع سقف شهر كامل في تنقّل واحد). Eligibility: legal working age; Algerian national residing in Algeria; no other profitable activity; valid auto-entrepreneur card under the Micro-Import activity code (080101); registered with CNAS; tax identification number; foreign-currency bank account at BEA; annual personal, non-transferable general license issued by the Ministry of Foreign Trade. Procedure: Apply and download the general license through the ANAE platform.

61.title: دليل الاستيراد المصغر (Micro-importer guide) - ANAE
61.text: general license issued by the Ministry of Foreign Trade. Procedure: Apply and download the general license through the ANAE platform. Declare the goods list on the platform before they reach the customs territory (personal and passport details, license number and date, expected arrival date, nature, origin, source country, value, quantity, unit). Upload purchase invoices or receipts; declare all goods for each trip in a single declaration. Excluded goods: prohibited or sensitive goods, sensitive equipment (Decree 09-410 as amended), pharmaceuticals, goods requiring special licenses, goods threatening security, public order or morals.

62.title: دليل الاستيراد المصغر (Micro-importer guide) - ANAE
62.text: equipment (Decree 09-410 as amended), pharmaceuticals, goods requiring special licenses, goods threatening security, public order or morals. Financing: entirely from the foreign-currency account; the international bank card is the only permitted payment method within the cap; cost of goods excludes the annual travel allowance. Compliance: remaining shelf life must exceed half the total at entry; labels in Arabic or an easily understood language showing importer name, product name, origin, source country and import date; sales use simplified delivery notes; post-market conformity checks apply.

63.title: دليل الاستيراد المصغر (Micro-importer guide) - ANAE
63.text: importer name, product name, origin, source country and import date; sales use simplified delivery notes; post-market conformity checks apply. Customs: cleared through a customs declaration generated from the platform data; a flat 5% of the goods' value is payable as duties and taxes; foreign trade, exchange and economic import-ban procedures are waived; preferential treatment under international agreements does not apply; excess over the cap is seized; prohibited goods lead to removal from the register and card cancellation. Removal and sanctions: besides Article 14 of Law 22-23, removal applies to breaches of consumer or national security rules, refusal to pre-declare goods, false declarations, misuse of the card, or violations of Decree 25-170.

65.title: Label Startup - startup.dz
65.text: Ce que c'est : Le label est un document institutionnel qui sert de passeport pour accéder aux facilités que l'État accorde aux startups. Il ne peut être obtenu qu'après la création de la société. Critères d'éligibilité : - Âge : la société ne doit pas avoir plus de huit ans d'existence. - Innovation : le modèle économique repose sur des produits ou services innovants. - Potentiel de croissance : l'entreprise doit présenter un potentiel de croissance important. - Chiffre d'affaires : le chiffre d'affaires annuel doit rester sous un plafond fixé par le comité national. - Actionnariat : au moins 50 % du capital doit appartenir à des personnes physiques, à des fonds d'investissement agréés ou à d'autres sociétés détentrices du label.

66.title: Label Startup - startup.dz
66.text: au moins 50 % du capital doit appartenir à des personnes physiques, à des fonds d'investissement agréés ou à d'autres sociétés détentrices du label. - Taille : la société ne doit pas compter plus de 250 salariés. Avantages : - Exonérations fiscales. - Accès aux autres facilités publiques réservées aux startups. - Éligibilité au financement de l'Algerian Startup Fund (ASF), qui intervient en fonds propres et quasi-fonds propres pour les entreprises labellisées. La procédure détaillée est renvoyée vers la page Pour les startups (startup.dz/pour-les-startups/).

67.title: Pour les startups - startup.dz
67.text: Label startup : il sert de passeport donnant accès aux facilités que l'État met à disposition des startups. Il n'est accessible qu'aux entreprises déjà créées. Conditions : - Âge : l'entreprise ne doit pas exister depuis plus de huit ans. - Innovation : son modèle d'affaires doit reposer sur des produits ou services innovants. - Potentiel de croissance important. - Chiffre d'affaires : il ne doit pas dépasser le plafond fixé par le comité national. - Capital social : au moins 50 % détenu par des personnes physiques, des fonds d'investissement agréés ou d'autres sociétés disposant du label Start-up. - Taille : pas plus de 250 employés.

68.title: Pour les startups - startup.dz
68.text: des personnes physiques, des fonds d'investissement agréés ou d'autres sociétés disposant du label Start-up. - Taille : pas plus de 250 employés. Label projet innovant : destiné aux porteurs de projets qui n'ont pas encore créé leur société ; il donne accès à des avantages comparables à ceux du label startup. Procédure : la labellisation se fait entièrement en ligne, via une plateforme ; aucune démarche auprès d'une administration n'est requise. Comité de labellisation : composé de représentants de ministères ayant une expérience professionnelle suffisante dans l'innovation ou les nouvelles technologies ; il peut faire appel à des personnes extérieures.

69.title: Assurance sociale des étudiants - CNAS
69.text: Affiliation : L'inscription à l'université permet de devenir assuré social, en souscrivant une immatriculation auprès de la CNAS. Pour obtenir la carte électronique de la sécurité sociale CHIFA, il faut se présenter au centre payeur situé dans la localité de l'établissement universitaire. Documents à fournir : - Le formulaire de demande d'immatriculation SECU01, téléchargeable sur le site web de la CNAS. - Une photocopie de la carte d'identité nationale. - Une photo d'identité sur fond clair. - Une photocopie de la carte de groupe sanguin. - Un extrait d'acte de naissance (n° 12). - Un bulletin d'inscription à l'université.

70.title: Assurance sociale des étudiants - CNAS

Prestations en nature (dès obtention du numéro d'immatriculation) : assurance maladie ; assurance maternité ; prestations liées aux accidents du travail, dont le capital décès et une rente pour les ayants droit en cas d'accident mortel. Obligations de l'étudiant : fournir un certificat de scolarité au début de chaque année universitaire ; répondre aux convocations du service de contrôle médical, si nécessaire. Paiement : pour bénéficier des prestations, déposer un chèque barré (CCP ou bancaire) auprès du centre d'affiliation. Contact : Route des Deux Bassins, Ben Aknoun, Alger. 71.title: Release of the National Pension System platform for Algerians abroad - Consulate General in Paris
71.text: The Consulate General of Algeria in Paris announces that Algerian nationals living abroad who want to join the National Retirement System (Système National de Retraite) can register on an online platform, as part of efforts to improve how the government handles matters for Algerians abroad. - Registration portal: teledeclaration.cnas.dz/el_djalya.xhtml - Eligibility and procedures: a PDF guide is available at consulat-paris-algerie.fr/4338/systeme-de-retraite-pdf The notice is issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and National Community Abroad and is dated 2023.

72.title: Préinscription et orientation - MESRS
72.text: Avant de postuler : les nouveaux bacheliers doivent lire la circulaire ministérielle annuelle de préinscription et d'orientation et le guide de l'étudiant qui l'accompagne. Saisie des choix : l'inscription se fait entièrement en ligne via les sites dédiés. Le candidat remplit une fiche de voeux en ligne comportant jusqu'à 10 choix par ordre de préférence décroissant (filières LMD, classes préparatoires, classes préparatoires intégrées, filières ou écoles à recrutement national, filières du système classique). La fiche est envoyée exclusivement par voie électronique. Traitement et affectation : un système informatisé national traite toutes les fiches selon trois paramètres de préinscription et d'orientation fixés par la circulaire.

73.title: Préinscription et orientation - MESRS
73.text: : un système informatisé national traite toutes les fiches selon trois paramètres de préinscription et d'orientation fixés par la circulaire. L'objectif est d'affecter chaque étudiant à l'un de ses 10 choix ; à défaut, une filière lui est proposée. Les résultats sont publiés sur les sites dédiés. Après l'affectation : l'étudiant se rend à l'établissement d'affectation pour déposer son dossier d'inscription, payer les frais, retirer les documents de confirmation d'inscription et obtenir l'emploi du temps. Recours : un étudiant non satisfait peut introduire un recours en ligne, uniquement si l'affectation ne correspond à aucun de ses 10 choix.

74.title: Préinscription et orientation - MESRS
74.text: temps. Recours : un étudiant non satisfait peut introduire un recours en ligne, uniquement si l'affectation ne correspond à aucun de ses 10 choix. Filières à concours ou sélectives : en cas de non-admission (concours, test d'aptitude, entretien), l'étudiant est réorienté vers un autre choix de sa liste, sous réserve des prérequis, via des conférences régionales. Les résultats doivent être communiqués au moins 72 heures avant la clôture des inscriptions définitives. Cas particuliers : les règles pour les mentions Excellent ou Très Bien, les diplômes étrangers et les bacheliers des sessions antérieures sont fixées chaque année dans la circulaire. Contact : 11 Chemin Doudou Mokhtar, Ben Aknoun, Alger ; +213 (0) 23-23-80-77 / +213 (0) 23-23-80-57 ; webmaster@mesrs.dz.

75.title: Ministerial circular for the new baccalaureate holders (July 2024) - MESRS
75.text: Key dates (2024-2025 intake; check the current year's circular for new dates): - July 23-27: preliminary registration for new baccalaureate holders. - August 6: orientation results announced. - August 10-15: registration fees payable. - July 25 to September 25: English language training for new students. Registration process: after paying fees, students enroll at their university and receive an electronic card, supporting the ministry's zero paper policy. Three QR codes support the process: the new bac holders' portal, preliminary registration and results, and final registration. Digital support tools: a portal with three apps: Tawjihouka (an interactive version of the circular), an AI-based orientation simulator, and a tool listing professions linked to a chosen major.

76.title: Ministerial circular for the new baccalaureate holders (July 2024) - MESRS
76.text: Tawjihouka (an interactive version of the circular), an AI-based orientation simulator, and a tool listing professions linked to a chosen major. New offers: a National Higher School of Cybersecurity at the Sidi Abdellah university pole; 32 new training offers (translation, architecture, science of matter, etc.); further offers including car manufacturing technology, textile engineering (Relizane) and Chinese language (Algiers 2); an art institute at Oran 1 for Art baccalaureate holders. Double degrees: students can enroll in two courses during the same study period; eight faculties offer medicine double degrees (with big data, AI, health economics, bioinformatics, medical psychology); four double-degree offers accredited at seven universities, including mathematics with computer science.

78.title: Statut Etudiant - MESRS
78.text: Qui est étudiant : toute personne inscrite dans un établissement d'enseignement supérieur pour préparer un diplôme, avec le baccalauréat ou un titre étranger équivalent comme condition d'accès. Les conditions d'accès sont fixées chaque année par circulaire ministérielle. Droits des étudiants : - Accès aux services d'enseignement, de recherche, aux activités culturelles et sportives. - Éligibilité aux bourses d'enseignement et/ou aux aides indirectes de l'État, sous conditions de revenus des parents. - Protection sociale et mesures sanitaires de prévention selon la législation en vigueur. - Hébergement en résidence universitaire, restauration et transport, selon les capacités disponibles. Bourse : versée tous les trois mois, elle dépend des revenus annuels des parents.

79.title: Statut Etudiant - MESRS
79.text: restauration et transport, selon les capacités disponibles. Bourse : versée tous les trois mois, elle dépend des revenus annuels des parents. Le dossier comprend notamment le formulaire fourni par l'administration, le baccalauréat, le certificat de scolarité, l'acte de naissance, des photos et des justificatifs de revenus adaptés à la situation des parents (salariés, non-salariés, retraités, décédés ou divorcés). Résidence universitaire : critère de distance de 50 km ou plus entre le domicile et l'établissement pour les garçons, 30 km ou plus pour les filles, avec une exception pour les zones géographiquement difficiles.

Restauration : tout étudiant, résident ou non, peut manger au restaurant universitaire sur présentation de sa carte d'étudiant. Contact : 023-23-80-77.

81.title: Suivi des boursiers et insertion - MESRS
81.text: Renouvellement de la bourse (formation à l'étranger) : - Conditions : accordé aux étudiants qui n'ont pas épuisé la durée réglementaire de prise en charge et qui justifient d'une progression pédagogique et scientifique régulière. - Dossier à déposer sur la plateforme : 1. la demande de renouvellement ; 2. le relevé de notes portant le cachet de l'établissement d'accueil ; 3. la fiche de suivi (modèle téléchargeable), visée par l'établissement d'accueil et par le poste consulaire. - Modalités : renouvellement annuel, traité par les services du MESRS et par le comité d'experts scientifiques de la Commission nationale de la formation et du perfectionnement à l'étranger. Les étudiants n'ont pas à se présenter en personne.

Insertion des boursiers : tout lauréat du concours national de formation à l'étranger ayant signé un contrat de formation doit suivre, pour le compte de l'organisme d'envoi, la formation initialement prévue ; il est tenu à une obligation de résultats. 84.title: Commander une carte EDAHABIA - Algérie Poste
84.text: Commander la carte EDAHABIA au bureau de poste (lors de l'ouverture d'un compte CCP) : - Cocher la case Délivrance d'une carte monétique sur le formulaire de demande d'ouverture de compte CCP. - Fournir votre numéro de téléphone mobile. - Un SMS confirme l'ouverture de votre compte et vous informe de la disponibilité de votre carte et de votre code PIN auprès de votre bureau de poste. Commander en ligne (edcarte.poste.dz) : - Saisir des informations exactes sur votre compte CCP existant. - Fournir votre numéro de téléphone mobile (obligatoire). - Lire et cocher la case d'acceptation des conditions d'utilisation de la carte EDAHABIA. - Saisir le code OTP reçu par SMS. - Vous recevrez un SMS lorsque votre carte et votre code PIN seront disponibles auprès de votre bureau de poste.

85.title: Commander une carte EDAHABIA - Algérie Poste
85.text: - Saisir le code OTP reçu par SMS. - Vous recevrez un SMS lorsque votre carte et votre code PIN seront disponibles auprès de votre bureau de poste. Conditions : disposer d'un compte CCP et accepter les conditions d'utilisation. La page n'indique pas de frais.

86.title: Consular Registration - Embassy of Algeria in Washington
86.text: Algerian nationals permanently living abroad are urged to register; registration is required for passport issuance and voter registration. Citizens aged 19 and older can register and receive a free consular card valid for five years. A married Algerian woman can be registered under her husband's file; children under 19 are registered with their parents. Documents can be submitted in person without an appointment, or by mail to the Embassy at 2133 Wyoming Ave NW, Washington, DC 20008. Transferring registration (after moving to another consular district): the Embassy handles the transfer once the file arrives from the previous post. Required: signed application, the expired card (or a Lost Report Form if lost or stolen), proof of legal U.S.

87.title: Consular Registration - Embassy of Algeria in Washington
87.text: file arrives from the previous post. Required: signed application, the expired card (or a Lost Report Form if lost or stolen), proof of legal U.S. residency, proof of address within the Embassy's jurisdiction, proof of employment or school enrollment, two passport-style photos; a copy of the U.S. entry visa and the passport photo page if applicable; a return envelope if mailing. First-time registration: signed application, the original full-version birth certificate, a parent's full birth or death certificate, proof of legal U.S. residency, proof of address, proof of employment or school enrollment, two passport-style photos. Applicants born outside Algeria must also provide either birth certificates of two paternal ancestors born in Algeria or a Certificate of Algerian Nationality.

An Algerian woman married to an Algerian national can be registered as a subsidiary under her husband's registration; children under 19 are registered as subsidiaries under their parents. First registration - required documents: 1. Completed application form, signed by the applicant. 2. Full birth certificate (copie intégrale). 3. Original full birth or death certificate of the applicant's father. 4. If born outside Algeria, the birth or death certificate of the applicant's grandfather, or a certificate of Algerian nationality. 5.

91.text: of pages 1, 2 and 3 and the visa page; without an Algerian passport, the Algerian identity card and/or military card may be required. 11. A stamped, self-addressed envelope if applying by post (recorded delivery recommended). Renewal: completed renewal form; previous registration card; two photos; proof of legal UK residence; proof of activity or enrolment; proof of UK address; stamped self-addressed envelope if by post. The birth certificate is not needed unless the applicant's situation has changed. Notes: incomplete postal applications are returned; incomplete in-person applications are not accepted. Processing usually takes 30 working days or more; more than 3 months if a passport has been lost.

92.title: Consular Registration - Consulate General of Algeria in London
92.text: in-person applications are not accepted. Processing usually takes 30 working days or more; more than 3 months if a passport has been lost. First registration requires original civil status records; faxed or photocopied records, even notarised, are not accepted. The card is valid for five years. Names are removed from the consular and electoral registers if the card is not renewed within 10 years. Fees: the registration card is free of charge.

93.title: Consular Registration - Consulate General of Algeria in Milan
93.text: Overview: registration is free and the card lasts five years, after which it must be renewed. Later changes to civil status, address or occupation must be reported with supporting documents. Anyone who permanently returns to Algeria must ask to be removed from the registers. First registration (adults) - originals plus A4 photocopies: - Completed, signed and dated application form - Algerian passport, including identity, visa and Schengen entry pages - Birth certificate (12 S) with a copy - Father's birth certificate, or the father's and grandfather's for those born abroad - Naturalization decree, if citizenship was acquired - Proof of family status (family record book, marriage certificate, or divorce judgment) - Residence permit showing an address in the jurisdiction, a renewal receipt,

94.title: Consular Registration - Consulate General of Algeria in Milan
94.text: status (family record book, marriage certificate, or divorce judgment) - Residence permit showing an address in the jurisdiction, a renewal receipt, or a valid national ID card of the host country - Proof of residence under three months old, or a city-hall-legalized accommodation certificate - Proof of activity (work certificate, payslips, school certificate, employment agency notice, disability or retirement notice, etc.) - Five passport-style photos (3.5 x 4.5 cm) A spouse must provide the same documents. Children of an Algerian parent are registered as dependents. Minors: legal guardian's registration card; child's birth certificate (12 S) with a copy; travel document or host-country ID for dual citizens; two photos; the legal guardian must be present.

95.title: Consular Registration - Consulate General of Algeria in Milan
95.text: child's birth certificate (12 S) with a copy; travel document or host-country ID for dual citizens; two photos; the legal guardian must be present. Renewal: expired registration card; signed, dated application form; proof of legal stay with a copy; if the address changed, a recent utility or telephone bill or a rental or property contract; two photos; work certificate, payslips or attendance certificate. Re-registration: registration lapses after a residence-ending certificate (CCR) is issued, a personal request, or an absence of more than ten years; re-registration uses the same documents as the first registration.

98.title: Entry visa to Algeria - Embassy of Algeria in Oslo
98.text: Regularization visa (visa on arrival): issued on arrival, exceptionally and in emergencies, by authorized authorities. Limited to tourists travelling to southern Algeria through authorized travel agencies (Ministry of Tourism and Handicrafts). Covered wilayas: Tamanrasset, Illizi, Tindouf, Adrar, Bechar, Timimoune, Djanet, Bordj Badji Mokhtar, Béni Abbes, Ain Salah, Touggourt. The agency provides a boarding authorization; the visa covers the duration of the organized tour. General requirements (all visa types unless noted): passport with at least six months' validity and at least two blank visa pages; two signed application forms with original signatures; two recent identical photos (white background, no glasses except prescription); travel insurance; payment of fees.

99.title: Entry visa to Algeria - Embassy of Algeria in Oslo
99.text: forms with original signatures; two recent identical photos (white background, no glasses except prescription); travel insurance; payment of fees. Children travelling with parents need their own visa and individual passport. Scanned or faxed documents are not accepted except in duly justified urgent cases. Visa types and documents: - Diplomatic/service: passport, two forms, two photos, note verbale; issued without expenses. - Press: three forms, two photos, proof of occupation (e.g. press card), employer guarantee letter; an Algerian partner's invitation may be required. - Tourist: proof of occupation or student status; one of: an invitation or lodging certificate legalized by the host's municipality, a hotel reservation, or a travel agency invitation; evidence of sufficient funds.

100.title: Entry visa to Algeria - Embassy of Algeria in Oslo
100.text: or lodging certificate legalized by the host's municipality, a hotel reservation, or a travel agency invitation; evidence of sufficient funds. - Business: employer guarantee letter stating trip purpose; Algerian partner invitation letter. - Study: enrolment confirmation at an accredited Algerian school, tuition payment evidence, proof of funds. - Work: certified employment contract, Algerian temporary work permit, employer repatriation letter. - Temporary work (max. 3 months): certified contract and Algerian temporary work permit. - Family: proof of relationship and host's invitation; spouses of registered Algerian citizens may submit the spouse's consular registration card. - Medical: medical certificate, hospital confirmation letter, proof of payment and funds.

101.title: Entry visa to Algeria - Embassy of Algeria in Oslo
101.text: may submit the spouse's consular registration card. - Medical: medical certificate, hospital confirmation letter, proof of payment and funds. - Cultural: invitation to the event, proof of funds. - Transit: visa or documentation for final destination, proof of funds; stopover permits of 2 to 7 days for ship and aircraft crews. Organized tourists using tourist agencies: visa issued within 48 hours of receiving a complete file. Validity and stay: validity of 90 days, 180 days, one year or two years. Maximum stay per entry 90 days, extendable exceptionally by up to 90 more days. Cumulative stay may not exceed 180 days per year. Transit visa stay: 7 days. Do not arrive before the entry date on the visa. Fees (Oslo): Norwegian citizens less than 90 days 1270 NOK; more than 90 days 1515 NOK.

102.title: Entry visa to Algeria - Embassy of Algeria in Oslo
102.text: 7 days. Do not arrive before the entry date on the visa. Fees (Oslo): Norwegian citizens less than 90 days 1270 NOK; more than 90 days 1515 NOK. Other nationalities: confirm with the Embassy. Fees are non-refundable if a visa is refused. Chancery fees may be waived for some nationalities under reciprocity. Processing: at least 15 working days at consular posts; no express service. Buying non-refundable tickets before visa issuance is discouraged. Visa-exempt nationalities (as listed): Libya, Malaysia, Maldives, Mali, Mauritania, Morocco, Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic, Seychelles, Tunisia. Mandatory travel insurance with repatriation applies to citizens of listed countries including EU states, Norway, Switzerland, Iceland, Canada, Australia and New Zealand.

103.title: National Military Service - Embassy of Algeria in Washington
103.text: Issuance of deferment and exemption cards: Algerian citizens with pending applications should contact the Office of Consular Affairs at (202) 265-2800, extension 169. Registration: National Service registration (Recensement) is required at age 18. The Embassy handles it automatically for Algerian nationals born in the United States and for those registered at the Embassy. Exemption by Presidential Decision: application form; original full birth certificate; two pictures; work or studies certificate; copy of consular card. Deferment: application form; two pictures; birth certificate; current-year studies certificate; copy of consular card.

104.title: National Military Service - Embassy of Algeria in Washington
104.text: copy of consular card. Deferment: application form; two pictures; birth certificate; current-year studies certificate; copy of consular card. Exemption for medical reasons: application / Fiche de Renseignements Service National; medical certificates; X-rays (if any); specialized medical test results; surgical operation protocol; clinical summary of the illness; hospitalization certificates; copy of consular card. Exemption for social reasons: letter addressed to the Ministry of National Defense; two recent photographs; family civil status record (if married); copies of diplomas, if any; work certificate; parents' family civil status record.

105.title: Military service - Exemption - Consulate General of Algeria in San Francisco
105.text: Three exemption categories, each requiring these base documents: - A copy of the applicant's consular registration card - The application form, completed electronically on-screen - Two recent passport photos, 2x2 inches (51x51 mm) - One original Algerian birth certificate (12S are not accepted) - One copy of the last diploma or school enrollment certificate - The original previous deferment document Presidential measures: no additional documents beyond the base set. Social reasons: also provide a letter addressed to the Ministry of National Defense, submitted through the Consulate, supporting the social grounds; an evidence file establishing the social situation (father's death certificate, parents' divorce decree, proof of the father's unemployment, retirement or disability, brothers'

106.title: Military service - Exemption - Consulate General of Algeria in San Francisco
106.text: the social situation (father's death certificate, parents' divorce decree, proof of the father's unemployment, retirement or disability, brothers' status regarding national service); a copy of the parents' family book. Medical reasons: also provide a medical file proving the disease or disability (medical certificates, X-rays, medical reports). For all categories, including a prepaid USPS Priority return envelope is recommended.

107.title: Services for non-registered citizens - Consulate General of Algeria in London
107.text: Services for non-registered citizens: - Power of attorney - Registration of a birth or marriage - Translation of Algerian documents, such as birth or marriage certificates, national ID cards and driving licences Eligibility: applicants must prove Algerian nationality. Accepted proof: an Algerian passport, a national identity card, or a military card with a photograph. Required documents: proof of identity and nationality (one of the accepted documents above); two photographs. Not accepted: driving licences; birth certificates, with or without a photograph; photocopies of any document; any foreign document.
